title: Why is my AC not cooling properly?
desc:
This can happen because of the following reasons:
  • Dirty Filters
  • Low Gas
  • Blocked Coils
  • Thermostat Problems
  • Compressor Issues
A professional inspection can identify the exact cause.

title: What causes water leakage from the AC?
desc:
Common causes include:
  • blocked drain pipes
  • frozen coils
  • dirty filters
  • drainage problems
Fixing the leak early prevents property damage.

title: Can AC cleaning improve cooling performance?
desc: Yes, cleaning removes dust and dirt from filters and coils, which improves airflow and helps your AC cool more effectively.
